info.title: Mission Control local API
info.description: Optional loopback-only development API using Express and SQLite. The hosted static game uses browser-local persistence, not this API. Requests are JSON with a 64 KB size limit. Cost is in USD millions, mass kg, power W, energy Wh, delta-v m/s; design altitude is km. No authentication is provided; keep this local API bound to 127.0.0.1.
